Goal (page): wf writes, chains and pushes worker reports itself, as designed in lab 90.50.10.0705, so the stopgap in docs/plan/REPORTS.md can retire. Band door: 90.50.10.0400. One page, five passes, one worker at a time (t531u, t533u, t541u). Acting lead and Prime: Claude (t562u).
Current pass: 05.01, report module and config. Pack text: labs/0422-plan/PACK-0422-05.01.txt on returns.
Builder: set at pack, one Grok builder (Matthew relays the prompt). Checker: Grok-Check.
Lab: 90.50.10.0705 (design, closed passed). The lab trial tests/lab_0422_01.rs is written on 90.50.10.0701 by another view after this pass closes. It is not a Done when line of this pass, because 0408.05.01 and 0419.05.01 both failed on a trial line their own pass could not meet.
Done when: src/report.rs exists and is declared in src/lib.rs.
Done when: wf setup writes and checks <WF_ROOT>/.wf/config.json, adds .wf/ to .git/info/exclude once, and runs a read-only verify of the worker's own N6 page; it appends no log entry and pushes nothing.
Done when: a config that is present but invalid refuses, naming the field and the file; with no config, wf behaves as before.
Done when: the outbox is drained only after the page lock is released, and only after a command that writes or reports, or on wf report --retry; read-only commands never fetch or push.
Done when: the outbox keeps its order, refuses unless the published page log is a prefix of the queued log, merges and never rebases, never forces, and leaves a refused item queued with a last line that says so.
Done when: cargo test --lib and cargo test --test page_0422_01 pass on the box.

band: 90.50.10.0400 (door)
lab: 90.50.10.0705 (design, closed passed); 90.50.10.0701 (trial files tests/lab_0422_0N.rs, written after each pass closes)
needs: 90.50.10.0408 closed; 90.50.10.0423 closed and its trial done; 90.50.10.0705 closed (done)
needed by: none for the 0498 MVP (t541u G8); a later strict pass for a missing config (0422.05.06 or a later 04NN page)
rule: page grant is the union of the five pass grants (t562u); one worker per page (t533u); passes are the work orders (t541u); plan labs/0422-plan/ on returns

Planned work for 90.50.10.0422 report-system. Source: labs/0422-plan/README.md (revision 2) on returns, with Prima's answers in docs/review/ANSWERS-0422-PLAN.md (prima/build 3c6d509). Design: lab 90.50.10.0705, closed passed.

Passes, in order, one at a time. Each pass holds only its own files:
05.01 report module and config: src/report.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/page_0422_01.rs
05.02 report log kind: src/page.rs, tests/page_0422_02.rs
05.03 commands write and push reports: src/cmd.rs, tests/page_0422_03.rs
05.04 report views and status: src/render.rs, src/status.rs, tests/page_0422_04.rs
05.05 report docs and setup on N6: docs/REPORTS.md, tests/page_0422_05.rs

Waits:
- 05.01 to 05.03 wait until 0408 and 0423 are closed and their trials are done (src/cmd.rs, src/lib.rs, src/page.rs).
- 0425 (book-prime) goes first on a shared file once it has a draft, and never cuts into an open 0422 pass (R2).
- 05.04 waits for 0407's trial and for any other open src/render.rs or src/status.rs holder.

Rules:
- The push runs from run() after the page lock is released, only after commands that write or report (C2).
- One prefix-checked push rule, shared with 0423's push_log (C3).
- A missing config warns and falls back to the stopgap; an invalid config refuses (C8, R5; Matthew M1 open).
- An offline return that wf cannot record follows docs/plan/MANUAL-RETURN.md (C6; Matthew M2 open).

Each pass gets a lab trial on 0701 after it closes. Face 01 is replaced before each pass with that pass's Done when lines.
